description: This is a Java test class for integration testing external asset owner transfer search functionality in the Fineract project. It contains test cases verifying search features by external ID, effective date, submitted date, and combined text and date filters.

classes.name: SearchExternalAssetOwnerTransferTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests for searching external asset owner transfer records with various filters such as external ID, effective date, submitted date, and text search within the Fineract project.

methods.name: saleActiveLoanToExternalAssetOwnerWithSearching
methods.description: Test case verifying search functionality by external ID and effective date after creating a sale transfer and performing subsequent searches.

methods.name: initialSearchExternalAssetOwnerTransferUsingTextTest
methods.description: Test case verifying search functionality using text query filtering the external asset owner transfer records.

methods.name: initialSearchExternalAssetOwnerTransferUsingEffectiveDateTest
methods.description: Test case verifying search functionality based on effective date range filters.

methods.name: initialSearchExternalAssetOwnerTransferUsingSubmittedDateTest
methods.description: Test case verifying search functionality based on submitted (settlement) date range filters.

methods.name: initialSearchExternalAssetOwnerTransferUsingTextAndDatesTest
methods.description: Test case verifying combined filtering by text and date ranges.

methods.name: validateResponse
methods.description: Helper method to validate the response contains expected number of transfer records.
